name: MONOREPO-001-F03 Publish app-suite and its Calendar release on GitHub

scenarios.name: MONOREPO-001-S06 Publish the migrated code without renaming the original repository

steps.text: the owner can publish to a new GitHub repository d-s-i/app-suite
the existing repository d-s-i/calendar is available
the owner publishes the reviewed app-suite code to d-s-i/app-suite
d-s-i/app-suite contains the migrated Calendar source, shared design and developer documentation
the pre-migration Git history and existing task identifiers remain available in the published project
d-s-i/calendar remains available at its existing address without deletion or renaming
no private signing credentials are included in the published files or history

scenarios.name: MONOREPO-001-S07 Owner verifies the Calendar APK in the new repository release

steps.text: the reviewed app-suite code is published to d-s-i/app-suite
a Calendar release APK has passed verification against the existing release certificate
its versionCode is greater than the Calendar release versions it is intended to replace
the owner publishes a Calendar release in d-s-i/app-suite and checks its attached APK
the release attachment is the verified Calendar release APK for app.local.calendar
the attachment can be downloaded by the owner from that release
the delivery record contains the release URL and the owner's verification result
